settings.congruence_h: A fan cools you. Not the room.
settings.congruence_1: Move a few feet away and you're hot again.
settings.congruence_2: A fan just pushes the hot air around. It can't bring cold air in.
settings.mech_1: Your AC sends cold air through ducts. The rooms close to it get the most. The room at the end gets the least.
settings.mech_2: By the time it gets there, it's a trickle.
settings.mech_caption: Same house. Same time. Same AC.
settings.hand_h: Put your hand on that vent.
settings.hand_sub: Do it while the AC is on.
settings.hand_yes_b: This fixes that. It pulls the cold air into the room.
settings.hand_no_b: Don't buy this. The duct is blocked, and no fan can fix that.

settings.attr_fits: 4x10 and 6x10 vents. Floor, wall or ceiling.
settings.fit_h: Measure the hole, not the cover.
settings.fit_1: Take off the old cover. Measure the hole under it. Most are 4x10.
settings.fit_2: Both sizes are 10 inches long. Measure the short side. That's the one that's different.
settings.swap_h: Wrong size? We'll swap it for free.
settings.swap_b: Measure again when it comes. If it's the wrong size, we'll send the right one.
settings.limits_1: This works if air comes out of the vent, but it's weak. It can't fix a vent with no air at all. That's a blocked duct.
settings.limits_2: It won't make a sunny room the coolest room in the house. It will make it a room you can use.
settings.stack_bundle_line: Have a second hot or cold room? This covers it.
settings.urgency_line: It's only going to get hotter.
settings.guar_h: 60 days. If the room doesn't change, send it back.
settings.guar_1: Try it on a hot day. If it doesn't help, email us and we'll give you your money back.
settings.guar_2: If it's broken, we pay for the return. If not, you do. We'd rather tell you now.
settings.faq_a_1: It fits 4x10 and 6x10 vents. Measure the hole, not the cover. Wrong size? We swap it free.
settings.faq_q_2: Does it work for heat too?
settings.faq_a_2: Yes. It pulls in whatever your system sends. Cold air in summer. Warm air in winter.
settings.faq_a_3: Any of them. The hole just needs to be one of the two sizes, near an outlet.
settings.faq_a_4: No. Two screws and a regular US plug. No wiring. No ductwork.
settings.faq_a_5: No. It's two small fans. It uses much less than a space heater or a portable AC.
settings.faq_q_7: What if it doesn't fix it?
settings.faq_a_7: Send it back within 60 days. If it's broken, we pay for the return. If not, you do.
settings.faq_q_8: Does it really cool the room, or just blow air?
settings.faq_a_8: It cools the room. A fan moves the hot air that's already there. This pulls in the cold air from your AC.
settings.faq_q_9: Why is only one room hot when the AC works everywhere else?
settings.faq_a_9: The rooms close to your AC get the cold air first. The last room gets what's left. Feel that vent with the AC on. Weak air means this is your problem.
settings.faq_q_10: How do I know it will work for my room?
settings.faq_a_10: Do the hand test. Weak air? This is for you. No air at all? Don't buy it. The duct is blocked.
settings.faq_a_11: You'll hear it on high, like a small fan. You can set it to run only when the room gets too warm.
settings.faq_q_12: How does the temperature setting work?
settings.faq_a_12: Pick the temperature you want in that room. It turns on when the room is too warm and off when it gets there.
settings.faq_q_13: Will it make the rest of the house warmer?
settings.faq_a_13: Other rooms may get a little less. Most of them were getting more than they needed.
settings.faq_q_14: Can I use one in two rooms?
settings.faq_a_14: One per vent. Most homes with one hot room have a second. That's what the 2-pack is for.
settings.final_sub: Two screws, one outlet, and 60 days to try it.
